about: Cases for classifyPush: what a compare-and-swap push's exit code and output mean. The stderr strings are real git output, trimmed. Every implementation of the protocol maps each case to `expected`.

cases.name: create of a ref already at the same sha
replace to the sha the ref already holds
lease check lost client-side
cases.stderr:
To /tmp/authority.git
 ! [rejected]        5d6e7f8 -> refs/locks/x (stale info)
error: failed to push some refs to '/tmp/authority.git'
